description: Job Search Assistant safeguards: every send waits for the person's one-click yes (never in LinkedIn, Reddit or X), check the job list after every change, run the posting check on everything read. Works with python3, python or py (Windows); if none is found, sending stays blocked.

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/no_send.py" 2>/dev/null || python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/no_send.py" 2>/dev/null || py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/no_send.py" || { echo "Job Search Assistant: Python was not found, so sending stays blocked. Install Python 3." >&2; exit 2; }
